description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose special  Commodity Levy on Maldive Fish, Black Gram, Chillies etc., w.e.f. 19.01.2018 for a  6 months period
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures specifying tax rates on various commodities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
